src/lib/components/flicker/FlickerSpinne.description:
FlickerSpinner — Dash wrapper for flicker-dot's player. The named presets
in dlc.flicker are this component with their frames filled in.

id.description: The ID used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

className.description: CSS class applied to the outer wrapper.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the outer wrapper.

grids.description:
The frames to play, in order, one every 150ms at rate 1.0. Each frame
is the 7x7 grid as 49 values, as 7 rows of 7, or as 7 strings of 7
characters where '#' is a lit dot. The named presets fill this in.

size.description: CSS pixel size (default 28, or 16 for the 5x5 variant).

color.description: Color of a lit dot (default currentColor).

on_opacity.description: Opacity of the lit dots, 0 to 1 (default 1).

off_color.description: Color of an unlit dot, drawn at `off_opacity` (default `color`).

off_opacity.description:
Opacity of the unlit dots, 0 to 1 (default 0.16). 0 leaves only the
lit dots; 1 paints `off_color` solid.

variant.description:
The grid: the full 7x7, its inner 5x5 (bigger dots), or the 7x7 padded
to 9x9 with a ring of unlit dots (smaller dots).

rotate.description:
Turn the animation clockwise, in degrees: 90 makes a loop that grows
upward grow to the right.

mirror.description: Mirror the animation left to right (before any rotation).

speed.description: Playback multiplier: 2 plays twice as fast.

aria_label.description: Accessible name, announced to assistive technology (default "Loading").

rate.description:
Relative tempo: 1.0 is this spinner's own tempo, 2.0 twice as fast,
0.5 half. Leave unset to keep the upstream tempo.

playing.description: Set to False to pause the animation.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the outer wrapper.

still.description: Disable animation while keeping the spinner visible.

rate.description:
Relative tempo: 1.0 is this spinner's own tempo, 2.0 twice as fast,
0.5 half. Leave unset to keep the upstream tempo.

playing.description: Set to False to pause the animation.
